headline: "The Situation Looks Tragic". Soaring Fuel Prices Are Finishing Them Off. Increases Foretold
summary: Record fuel prices at stations and wholesale are already hurting Polish transport companies. One Bydgoszcz operator said it is raising prices by 1 zloty per kilometre.
why: Fuel is a major cost for road haulage, so sustained price spikes feed into freight rates and inflation. Transport operators are often the first to pass these costs on to customers.
